interaction_resolutions.resolution: Strategic Acumen selects a Combat Doctrine, so it uses the shared once-per-battle selection allowance for that doctrine. A rule that only makes an already selected doctrine active for another unit, such as Demi-company Commander, does not make a second selection. Gladius Codex Discipline permits one additional selection of a doctrine, including a selection made through Strategic Acumen.

A rule applying to a unit or models in that unit applies to every model in the Attached unit while its source unit remains. A rule naming a specific model applies only to that model. Finest Hour therefore modifies only the Captain model's melee attacks; unit abilities such as Tactical Precision apply to attacks by the Attached unit while the Lieutenant source remains.

The current core text grants 1 Core CP to each player during each Command phase and has no general one-CP-per-battle-round gain cap in the consulted CP rules. Transhuman Strategist grants 1 CP at the start of the battle round when its Warlord is not destroyed. Teleport Homer reduces the 1 CP Rapid Ingress use by 1; the general CP-cost rule floors the resulting cost at 0 CP.

Tactical Mainstay removes the Battle-shock and Engagement restrictions on starting an Action, and starting that Action does not remove shooting eligibility. The current core FAQ says a unit with a rule allowing it to start an Action while Battle-shocked can continue that Action if it becomes Battle-shocked after starting it. Other independent restrictions still apply.

After a unit finishes all attacks each time it was selected to shoot or fight, make one Hazard roll per selected weapon with HAZARDOUS. A roll of 1-2 fails; each failure inflicts 1 mortal wound on the unit, or 3 if every model in the unit is a MONSTER or VEHICLE. Resolve multiple rolls for the unit simultaneously. Mortal wounds are allocated to the unit normally; they are not assigned to the model that used a hazardous weapon.

When a rule secures an objective, it remains under that player control even after their units leave range, until the opponent level of control exceeds theirs at the end of a phase. The core FAQ allows a unit to secure an objective it took control of at end of Movement in that same phase.

The Incursor Squad datasheet currently has Haywire Mine. The Pilum Strike Team Boarding Actions Rules Adaptation explicitly removes that ability in that format; this exception does not replace the general datasheet ability.

definitions.duration: Until the start of the controlling player's next Command phase.
limits: Each doctrine can be selected once per battle unless another rule explicitly changes that limit.

unit_abilities.duration: While the model has the selected loadout.
interactions_to_validate: Equipment choice is per model and reversible during preparation.
The point adjustment is checked against the admitted points limit.

unit_abilities.name: Into the Fray
unit_abilities.timing: After this unit made a Charge move this turn, when resolving its melee attacks.
unit_abilities.eligibility: This unit made a Charge move this turn.
unit_abilities.effect: This unit's melee attacks have Cleave 1.
unit_abilities.duration: For the remainder of the turn.
interactions_to_validate: The charge state applies to the attached unit.
Cleave 1 is consumed by the shared attack-plan target/model-count calculation.

unit_abilities.name: Lord of the Pyroclasts
unit_abilities.timing: While an enemy unit is engaged with Adrax's current attached unit.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Enemy unit is engaged with Adrax's current attached unit.
unit_abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from each enemy model's OC, to a minimum of 0.
unit_abilities.duration: While the engagement condition holds.
interactions_to_validate: The effect follows Adrax's current attached unit and ends when engagement ends.
Battle-shock still sets OC to 0 under the core rule.

unit_abilities.name: Unto the Anvil
unit_abilities.timing: When resolving this attached unit's melee attacks.
unit_abilities.eligibility: This unit is resolving melee attacks.
unit_abilities.effect: Re-roll wound rolls of 1; if Assault Doctrine is active for this unit, re-roll wound rolls.
unit_abilities.duration: For those melee attacks.
interactions_to_validate: Assault Doctrine state is checked for the attached unit when attacks are declared.
Wound-roll re-roll limits remain shared with the attack engine.

unit_abilities.name: Veteran Bodyguard
unit_abilities.timing: While Kaius is attached to a unit.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Another Character model is part of Kaius's attached unit.
unit_abilities.effect: That other Character model has Feel No Pain 4+ against any wounds.
unit_abilities.duration: While Kaius remains attached to that unit.
interactions_to_validate: The bearer does not gain this other-Character benefit.
The living attached source and recipient model identity are tracked separately.

unit_abilities.name: Calgar's Champion
unit_abilities.timing: When resolving Kaius's attacks.
unit_abilities.eligibility: The target unit has the Character keyword.
unit_abilities.effect: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1 for Kaius's attacks.
unit_abilities.duration: For those attacks.
interactions_to_validate: Other models in Kaius's attached unit do not receive the re-roll.
The target must be an enemy Character unit.

unit_abilities.name: Veil of Time
unit_abilities.timing: Librarian's Movement phase, before it moves; preselect the power before choosing Advance.
unit_abilities.eligibility: The Librarian's unit is not Battle-shocked, has not moved, and is eligible to Advance.
unit_abilities.effect: Make one D6 psychic roll. On a 1, the unit becomes Battle-shocked. The unit can change its Advance roll to 6; this replacement is applied after the ordinary Advance re-roll decision and before modifiers.
unit_abilities.duration: The selected Movement phase's Advance move.
interactions_to_validate: Battle-shock from a psychic roll of 1 does not prevent the unit from Advancing.
The optional Command Re-roll window occurs before the replacement; Advance modifiers apply after the replacement.
The Librarius level-1 limit is shared with Force Dome and the two other Librarian level-1 powers.

unit_abilities.name: Force Dome
unit_abilities.timing: Librarian's Movement phase, before it moves.
unit_abilities.eligibility: The Librarian's unit is not Battle-shocked.
unit_abilities.effect: Make one D6 psychic roll. On a 1, the unit becomes Battle-shocked. The unit has a 4+ invulnerable save until the start of its next turn; a better invulnerable save remains in effect.
unit_abilities.duration: Until the start of the Librarian unit's next turn.
interactions_to_validate: A psychic roll of 1 causes Battle-shock and the invulnerable save still applies.
Every model in the current attached unit receives the save, and the modifier expires at the caster's next turn start.
The Librarius level-1 limit is shared with Veil of Time and the other Librarian level-1 powers.

unit_abilities.name: Cold and Calculating
unit_abilities.timing: When this unit is selected to attack in your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Choose one target-conditional attack effect; Tactical Doctrine can make both effects active.
unit_abilities.effect: Lethal Hits against MONSTER or VEHICLE targets, or Sustained Hits 1 against other targets. With Tactical Doctrine active, apply both target-conditional effects.
unit_abilities.duration: For attacks made by this unit in the selected phase.
interactions_to_validate: The selection can be made once for this unit when selected to attack in each phase.
Lethal Hits only applies against MONSTER or VEHICLE targets.
Sustained Hits 1 only applies against targets with neither keyword.
Tactical Doctrine grants both effects concurrently.

unit_abilities.name: Cerebrex Logic Engine
unit_abilities.timing: During army preparation, in the Declare Battle Formations step.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Select one friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.
unit_abilities.effect: The selected unit gains Scouts 6.
unit_abilities.duration: For its pre-battle Scout move or Strategic Reserve set-up.
interactions_to_validate: Selection is optional and limited to one target for Caanok Var.
The target must be a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.
The chosen unit uses the ordinary Scout 6 workflow, including coherency and enemy separation.

unit_abilities.name: Hood Of Hellfire
unit_abilities.timing: While Chief Librarian Tigurius is leading a unit.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Tigurius and the models in his unit suffer damage from Psychic attacks or mortal wounds.
unit_abilities.effect: Those models have Feel No Pain 4+ against that damage.
unit_abilities.duration: While Tigurius is leading the unit.
interactions_to_validate: Protection applies to the attached unit, including bodyguards.
Psychic and mortal-wound prevention use their respective normal damage pathways.

unit_abilities.name: Prescience
unit_abilities.timing: Chief Librarian Tigurius uses this psychic ability in your Movement phase.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Tigurius is alive and his unit is not Battle-shocked.
unit_abilities.effect: Make a psychic test; on 1 his unit becomes Battle-shocked. His unit gains +1 to saving throws.
unit_abilities.duration: Until the start of your next turn.
interactions_to_validate: Prescience is level 2 and is independent of Telepathic Assault level 1.
The saving throw bonus composes with other modifiers and is frozen by the normal attack declaration snapshot.

unit_abilities.name: Telepathic Assault
unit_abilities.timing: Chief Librarian Tigurius uses this psychic ability in your Shooting phase.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Tigurius is alive and his unit is not Battle-shocked; select a visible enemy unit within 24 inches.
unit_abilities.effect: Make a psychic test; on 1 his unit becomes Battle-shocked. The selected enemy suffers 2D3 mortal wounds.
unit_abilities.duration: Resolve all mortal wounds through normal allocation and prevention.
interactions_to_validate: Telepathic Assault is level 1 and is independent of Prescience level 2.
The listed effect still resolves after a psychic roll of 1.
Mortal-wound allocation routes to the defending player and honors applicable Feel No Pain.

unit_abilities.name: Trifold Path Of Shadow
unit_abilities.timing: While Kayvaan Shrike is alive and on the battlefield.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Shrike and his attached unit are within detection range or are selected as ranged targets.
unit_abilities.effect: Shrike’s unit has Stealth and subtracts 3 inches from the detection range applied to it.
unit_abilities.duration: While the source model is alive and on the battlefield.
interactions_to_validate: The ability remains unit-wide while Shrike is attached.
The modifier composes with ground-level detection and Chameleoline Cloaks detection adjustments.

unit_abilities.name: Echo Of The Ravenspire
unit_abilities.timing: At the end of your opponent’s Fight phase.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Kayvaan Shrike’s unit is alive, on the battlefield and unengaged.
unit_abilities.effect: You can place the unit in Strategic Reserves.
unit_abilities.duration: Until the unit makes a subsequent ingress move or the battle ends.
interactions_to_validate: This response belongs to Shrike’s controlling player during the opponent’s Fight phase.
The unit leaves the battlefield as a whole and uses the existing Strategic Reserves ingress rules.

unit_abilities.name: Knight Champion of Macragge
unit_abilities.timing: During the opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move.
unit_abilities.eligibility: The enemy unit is within 8 inches of Cato’s unit, and Cato’s unit is unengaged.
unit_abilities.effect: Cato’s unit may make a Normal Move of up to 6 inches.
unit_abilities.duration: Once per phase per army.
interactions_to_validate: Range is checked after the enemy unit completes its move.
The unit must preserve coherency, legal movement and an unengaged endpoint.

unit_abilities.name: Honour or Death
unit_abilities.timing: When Cato’s unit is targeted with Heroic Intervention.
unit_abilities.eligibility: The target unit contains a living Cato Sicarius.
unit_abilities.effect: Reduce the CP cost by 1, to a minimum of 0.
unit_abilities.duration: For that stratagem use.
interactions_to_validate: The discount applies to Heroic Intervention only.
The minimum cost is 0 CP.

unit_abilities.name: Captain of the Honour Guard
unit_abilities.timing: When the army includes a Marneus Calgar unit.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Cato Sicarius is in that army.
unit_abilities.effect: Replace Leader with Support only when Marneus Calgar is in the army; Cato can still attach to the same source-listed units.
unit_abilities.duration: While the army includes Calgar.
interactions_to_validate: The replacement must not broaden Cato’s Leader target list.
When Calgar is present, Cato is not eligible as Warlord.

unit_abilities.name: Glory of Ultramar
unit_abilities.timing: Opponent Shooting phase, after an enemy unit has shot.
unit_abilities.eligibility: A Victrix Honour Guard model was destroyed by those attacks.
unit_abilities.effect: The unit can make a Surge move of up to D6 inches.
unit_abilities.duration: Resolve immediately after the enemy unit’s shooting attack.
interactions_to_validate: Only casualties allocated to the Victrix unit by this enemy shooting attack trigger the reaction.
Local placement checks enforce the rolled distance, legal board position, path, non-overlap and coherency.

unit_abilities.name: Honour Guard of Macragge
unit_abilities.timing: Whenever attacks target this unit.
unit_abilities.eligibility: The target is the Victrix Honour Guard unit.
unit_abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from the attack’s wound roll.
unit_abilities.duration: For each attack targeting the unit.
interactions_to_validate: Apply across Strength-versus-Toughness comparisons and attached models in the unit.
unit_abilities.composition_limit: Current admission exposes only the fixed Ancient+Champion compositions at 3 and 6 total models; other source-legal role mixes are not selectable.

unit_abilities.name: Banner of Macragge
unit_abilities.timing: End of the owner’s Movement phase; or once per battle per army when selected to fight.

unit_abilities.duration: Objective security persists under the objective rules; combat bonuses apply to the unit’s selected fight.
interactions_to_validate: Objective control and securing are tracked as separate states.
The melee bonus is used once per battle per army.
unit_abilities.composition_limit: Current admission exposes only the fixed Ancient+Champion compositions at 3 and 6 total models; other source-legal role mixes are not selectable.

unit_abilities.name: Trophy Taker
unit_abilities.timing: Each time this unit makes an attack.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Kor’sarro Khan is in the unit and the target is a CHARACTER unit.
unit_abilities.effect: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.
unit_abilities.duration: For the attack, while Kor’sarro Khan is in the unit.
interactions_to_validate: Applied to the final target unit keywords and retained through split attack batches.

unit_abilities.name: For the Khan!
unit_abilities.timing: Each time this unit makes an attack.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Kor’sarro Khan is in the unit.
unit_abilities.effect: The unit’s ranged attacks have Assault; its melee attacks have Lance.
unit_abilities.duration: While Kor’sarro Khan is in the unit.

unit_abilities.name: Press the Attack
unit_abilities.timing: Each time this unit makes a melee attack.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Captain Titus is in the unit.
unit_abilities.effect: The attack gains Sustained Hits 1 if the target has neither MONSTER nor VEHICLE; alternatively, if Assault Doctrine is active for the unit, the attack gains Sustained Hits 1 against any target.
unit_abilities.duration: For the unit’s melee attacks while the stated condition applies.
interactions_to_validate: Target keywords and Assault Doctrine are evaluated at attack declaration.

unit_abilities.name: Righteous Fury
unit_abilities.timing: In the Fight phase, when this unit is selected to fight; after it has fought.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Once per battle per army.
unit_abilities.effect: When activated, melee attacks gain +1 Strength. After the unit fights, Titus heals D3 wounds; if he destroyed an enemy model this phase, he heals 2D3 instead. Healing cannot exceed his Wounds characteristic.
unit_abilities.duration: Strength bonus lasts through this unit’s attacks; the ability can be used once per battle per army.
interactions_to_validate: Destroying an enemy model is taken from the resolved fight attack result.
Healing uses the host dice provider and is capped at maximum Wounds.

unit_abilities.name: Honour of Ultramar
unit_abilities.timing: In the Fight phase, when Titus is destroyed, before his unit has been selected to fight.
unit_abilities.eligibility: Roll one D6.
unit_abilities.effect: On 2+, do not remove Titus from the battlefield. Remove him after his unit has fought, or at end of the Fight phase, whichever comes first.
unit_abilities.duration: Until the unit fights or the Fight phase ends.
interactions_to_validate: Other units fighting do not remove Titus early.
A failed roll leaves the model destroyed.
